ksu_userspace: ksud 5518552 B shipped in the zip, installed to /data/adb/ksud

manager.note: kernel built with this certificate; the old manager APK is not accepted by this kernel and the new APK is not accepted by older kernels

installer: ci/release/anykernel.sh (boot backup + rollback before write, ksud install, no auto reboot)
why: 1.14 proved the chronicle-base recipe boots and gives root on this phone. This build only replaces the release identity with ours (CONFIG_LOCALVERSION -> 4.14.357-openela-SYNTHETICA-PULSE-1.16), so the next step is not taken on an unproven base. Every other config value, patch and tool is identical to 1.14.

identity_change.only_knob: CONFIG_LOCALVERSION (byte-identical sources, patches, profiles and toolchain)
identity_change.expected_side_effect: vermagic changes, so /vendor modules built for this ROM keep being rejected - exactly as they already were

known_good_reference.device_result: boot + root confirmed on 2026-10-29 (su in Termux gave uid 0)

provenance_note: Kernel sources are GPL-2.0 upstream + graziemille's Rollercoaster changes; see ci/rollercoaster/README.md and licenses/ for attribution.
policy: module signature enforcement left as the recipe sets it; nothing disabled, no SELinux bypass, no vbmeta/firmware writes
test_protocol: boot must be observed on the device before any claim of a fix
installer backs up the current boot partition first; restore it if the device does not boot
on failure: flash the log collector and send <storage>/synthetica-logs/<timestamp>/
